en: The image shows a panoramic view of a historic European city nestled in a valley, surrounded by mountains. The buildings have red-tiled roofs and there are notable towers and church spires visible. The foreground has a distinctive red-brick tower and a castle-like structure. The top left of the image has the printed text 'TRENTO - Panorama'. The coloring and style suggest the postcard is vintage, likely hand-tinted.
